name: Hornero Network Monitor
description: Network Monitor 2.0: dashboard card over the shared PluginKit Network facade with the 1.x speeds and session totals plus in-card history, peak readouts and honest unavailable states. Read-only.
author: HorneroOS contributors

changelog.notes: Dashboard card on the shared Network facade: 1.x speeds and session totals plus history sparkline, peak readouts, honest unavailable state, typed settings and Spanish catalog.
Dashboard card with download/upload speeds and session totals from the PluginKit Network service.

showSessionTotals.description: Show downloaded/uploaded session totals from the Network service (the 1.x behaviour).

showHistory.description: Show the in-card speed history sampled from the shared Network facade while the card is loaded.

sampleSeconds.description: Seconds between history samples read from the already-live shared Network facade.
